evals.name: check-reports-overlay-and-routes-reconfig-natively
evals.expected_output: The check action reads the three rendered ${user_config.batch_*} values and reports the effective posture-batch overlay (excluded / promoted / demoted correctors and the net effect, or that the tiers run as declared when all unset). It routes any reconfiguration to /plugin configure re-anchor and never edits settings.json or pluginConfigs. No apply action is offered.
expectations: Reports the effective batch overlay from the userConfig values, read-only
Routes reconfiguration to the native /plugin configure re-anchor flow, never hand-editing pluginConfigs

evals.name: unexpanded-token-treated-as-unset
evals.expected_output: When an option was never configured and its ${user_config.…} token survives literally (a zero-config or headless install), the check treats it as unset — no overlay from that key — and does not parse the literal placeholder as a corrector name. Both an empty value and a surviving literal placeholder read as unset.
expectations: Treats a surviving literal ${user_config.…} token as unset, not a value
Does not parse the literal placeholder as a corrector name
Treats an empty value and an unexpanded token identically (unset)

evals.name: validates-names-against-installed-correctors
evals.expected_output: The check globs the installed corrector directories and validates each overlaid name. It reports point-dont-copy as a valid exclusion and flags notaskill as a FAIL (matches no installed corrector), with remediation to fix the value through the plugin configuration prompt. It flags contradictions (a name both excluded and promoted/demoted) and no-op promotes/demotes.
expectations: Validates overlay names against the globbed installed correctors
Flags an unknown corrector name as a FAIL with native-reconfiguration remediation
Reports contradictions and no-op promote/demote entries
